title: Billing Desk Worksheet: Remake Charge for a Customer Specification Error (Factory Production Orders)
content:
For Factory Production Orders, the charge for a remake recorded with cause customer specification error is fixed as follows.

**Charge base.** The charge base is the class remake charge per unit times the units remade on the remake recorded with cause customer specification error.

**Remake charge.** The remake charge is the charge base rounded to the cent.

## Inputs

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| units remade | the remake record with cause customer specification error on the order's milestone records |
| class remake charge per unit | the order's build class |

## Worked examples (hypothetical remakes)

| Build class | Class remake charge per unit | Units remade | Remake charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build | 189.00 | 2 | 378.00 |
| Custom Color Build | 229.00 | 1 | 229.00 |
| Specialty Shape Build | 312.00 | 3 | 936.00 |
| Architectural Wood Build | 486.00 | 4 | 1,944.00 |

## Points of reading

- The units are those on the remake record itself, not the units on the whole order.
- The charge is dated the remake date.
